author: Sooner State News
title: Three Seminole State College students awarded Kay Edwards Memorial Scholarship
text:
Three Seminole State College students awarded Kay Edwards Memorial Scholarship
Elizabeth Jackson and Jaelyn Robertson, both of Chandler, and Caden Pierce of Seminole were selected as recipients of the Professional Staff Council/Kay Edwards Memorial Scholarship at Seminole State College, according to a July 15 announcement.
The scholarship provides $500 awards to SSC students who are enrolled in at least three credit hours during the summer session. Jackson and Pierce are business majors, while Robertson is pursuing a degree in the college’s medical laboratory technology program.
The students were recognized on July 14 by members of the Professional Staff Council in the Walkingstick Building on campus. Pierce was not present for the recognition event. Those pictured with the recipients included Financial Assistance Specialist Lauryn Flewallen, Director of NASNTI Kay Wallace, Director of Enrollment Management Edith Cathey, Financial Aid Specialist Alicia Ryan, Recruitment Specialist Maddie Potter, Registrar Sheila Morris, and NASNTI Computer Science Specialist Alecia Bailey.
The Kay Edwards Memorial Scholarship is named in honor of a former staff member and aims to support students pursuing their academic goals during summer enrollment periods.
More information about this year’s scholarship recipients can be found on the Seminole State College website.
